<description>
`coinstatsindex` was updated in an incompatible way in v30 (see #30469) and moved to the `indexes/coinstatsindex` folder. The old `indexes/coinstats` directory was kept and a warning was logged so users could still downgrade to v29 without resyncing the index.

There was a TODO in the code that scheduled the deletion for v31. Since v32 branch-off has happened, this would now ship in v33. By then 29.x should be EOL assuming we are not going to release a v29.5.
</description>

<commits>
397c6c5c1c index: Delete old coinstats index directory on startup

82e4cc6964 doc: Add release note for old coinstatsindex directory deletion
</commits>

         self.cleanup_folder(node.chain_path / "indexes" / "coinstatsindex")
         shutil.copytree(legacy_node.chain_path / "indexes" / "coinstats", node.chain_path / "indexes" / "coinstats")

         self.wait_until(lambda: node.getindexinfo()['coinstatsindex']['synced'] is True)

         assert_equal(res2, res0)
diff --git a/doc/release-notes-coinstatsindex-cleanup.md b/doc/release-notes-coinstatsindex-cleanup.md
new file mode 100644

--- /dev/null
+++ b/doc/release-notes-coinstatsindex-cleanup.md
@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+Indexes
+-------
+
+- The old version of the coinstatsindex at `indexes/coinstats/`, which was
+  superseded in v30.0, is now deleted automatically on startup when
+  `-coinstatsindex` is enabled. Downgrading to v29 or earlier afterwards
+  requires syncing the index from scratch again.

--- a/src/index/coinstatsindex.cpp

@@ -31,6 +31,7 @@

+#include <system_error>
 #include <utility>
 #include <vector>
 
@@ -91,13 +92,14 @@ CoinStatsIndex::CoinStatsIndex(std::unique_ptr<interfaces::Chain> chain, size_t
 {
     // An earlier version of the index used "indexes/coinstats" but it contained
     // a bug and is superseded by a fixed version at "indexes/coinstatsindex".
-    // The original index is kept around until the next release in case users
-    // decide to downgrade their node.
     auto old_path = gArgs.GetDataDirNet() / "indexes" / "coinstats";
     if (fs::exists(old_path)) {
-        // TODO: Change this to deleting the old index with v31.
-        LogWarning("Old version of coinstatsindex found at %s. This folder can be safely deleted unless you " \
-            "plan to downgrade your node to version 29 or lower.", fs::PathToString(old_path));
+        std::error_code ec;
+        if (DestroyDB(fs::PathToString(old_path / "db")) && fs::remove(old_path, ec)) {
+            LogInfo("Deleted old version of coinstatsindex at %s", fs::PathToString(old_path));
+        } else {
+            LogWarning("Failed to delete old version of coinstatsindex at %s, please remove it manually.", fs::PathToString(old_path));
+        }
     }
     fs::path path{gArgs.GetDataDirNet() / "indexes" / "coinstatsindex"};
     fs::create_directories(path);
